periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward from the medial to lateral edge relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval; the primary axis is approximately 1.5 times the length of the secondary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a distinct teardrop profile with the visual mass concentrated in the lower quadrant.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile at the posterior margin where the black band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the dark band occupies approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso height from the shoulder ridge.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the lateral gap between ears is approximately 1.2 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular curvature with no visible flattening at the superior boundary.
